name: SikaRapid® AF
summary: SikaRapid® AF is a non chloride set accelerator for concrete and mortar.
metaDescription: SikaRapid® AF is a non chloride set accelerator for concrete and mortar.
usage: SikaRapid® AF is recommended for use in premix and precast concrete where accelerated setting time is required. As a result, SikaRapid®-AF allows:
Improved early strength of premixed concrete.
Used in ready mix concrete in cold weather.
advantages: Can be used alone or in conjunction with a water reducer or a superplasticiser. Faster demoulding Reduces the risk of damage by freezing when pouring with cold temperature by shortening the plastic phase of the concrete.

items.label: APPROVALS / CERTIFICATES
items.text: SikaRapid® AF meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for Accelerator (Ac).

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Stored at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and from frost, shelf life is 12 months.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store SikaRapid® AF at 5°/35°, protected from the direct sunlight.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text:
SikaRapid® AF can be used in conjunction with any non-retarded Sika plasticiser or superplasticiser. It is beneficial to add SikaRapid® AF with the initial mixing water before the addition of superplasticiser to enhance strength development. Tests must be carried out to determine the optimum combination.
Do not useSikaRapid® AF in conjunction with shrinkage compensating admixtures.

items.label: Dispensing
items.text: SikaRapid® AF is added to batching water or is poured into the concrete mix at the same time as the gauging water. SikaRapid® AF may also be added into the agitator truck on site. In this case, the concrete should then be mixed for an extra 1 minute for every cubic metre of concrete. The concrete should then be checked visually for uniform consistency before discharging.

items.label: Recommended dosage
items.text: Dosage is 400ml - 2000ml/100 kg of total cementitious material. Exact dosage rate should be determined by site trials.
